moral_character_required.quote: Is trustworthy, of good moral character, and competent to transact the business of a broker, associate broker, or salesperson;

exams.notes: Examination or examinations provided by the commission; applicants under reciprocity must pass the West Virginia state law portion
exams.quote: Successfully pass the examination or examinations provided by the commission.

interval_years.quote: Be valid for a period that coincides with the fiscal year beginning on July 1 and ending on June 30.

required.quote: Every licensee shall complete seven hours of continuing professional education for each fiscal year, with each hour equaling 50 minutes of instruction.

hours_per_period.quote: Every licensee shall complete seven hours of continuing professional education for each fiscal year

period_years.quote: Every licensee shall complete seven hours of continuing professional education for each fiscal year

value: For brokers and associate brokers: 3 of the required 7 hours must be from the broker-level education curriculum approved by the commission
topical_requirements.quote: For brokers and associate brokers, three of the required seven hours shall be from the broker-level education curriculum approved by the commission.

available.quote: The commission may recognize a valid license issued by another jurisdiction as satisfactorily qualifying an applicant who is licensed to practice real estate brokerage in another jurisdiction to obtain a comparable license in this state

requirements.value: Applicant must have qualified by examination in the other jurisdiction and complied with all provisions for obtaining a license there; the other jurisdiction must afford the same privilege to WV licensees; applicant must pass the WV state law portion of the exam, submit certification of licensure and disciplinary records, and non-residents must designate the executive director as agent for service of process.
requirements.quote: the applicant has qualified for license in another jurisdiction by examination and by complying with all the provisions for obtaining a license in that jurisdiction and the jurisdiction affords the same privilege to licensees of this state.

exists.quote: The West Virginia Real Estate Commission is hereby continued.

national_association.quote: the appointment of one licensed commissioner, whether for a full term or to fill a vacancy, shall be made by the Governor from among three nominees selected by the West Virginia association of realtors.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining or renewing a license through false, fraudulent, or misleading application or writing
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtains, renews, or attempts to obtain or renew a license, for himself, herself, or another, through the submission of any application or other writing that contains false, fraudulent, or misleading information;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making any substantial misrepresentation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Makes any substantial misrepresentation;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making false promises or representations likely to influence persons in real estate transactions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Makes any false promises or representations of a character likely to influence, persuade, or induce a person involved in a real estate transaction;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Pursuing a course of misrepresentation through agents or advertising
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Pursues a course of misrepresentation or makes false promises or representations through agents or any medium of advertising or otherwise;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using misleading or false advertising
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Uses misleading or false advertising;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using trade name or insignia of an organization in which the licensee is not a member
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Uses any trade name or insignia of membership in any organization in which the licensee is not a member;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting for more than one party without written consent of all parties
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Acts for more than one party in a transaction without the knowledge and written consent of all parties for whom he or she acts;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to account for or remit money belonging to others within a reasonable time
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fails, within a reasonable time, to account for or to remit moneys or other assets coming into his or her possession, which belong to others;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commingling money belonging to others with the licensee's own funds
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Commingles moneys belonging to others with his or her own funds;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising or displaying a for-sale or for-rent sign without an agency relationship or owner's written consent
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertises or displays a "for sale", "for rent", or other such sign on any property without an agency relationship being established or without the owners knowledge and written consent;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising property on terms other than those authorized by the owner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertises any property on terms other than those authorized by the owner;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to disclose whether the licensee represents the seller, buyer, or both on the agency relationship form
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fails to disclose, on the notice of agency relationship form promulgated by the commission, whether the licensee represents the seller, buyer, or both;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to furnish copies of agency relationship, listing, sale, or other contracts to executing parties
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fails to voluntarily furnish copies of the notice of agency relationship, listing contract, sale contract, lease contract, or any other contract to each party executing the same;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Paying or receiving undisclosed rebates, profits, or compensation from real estate transactions outside permitted channels
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Pays or receives any rebate, profit, compensation, commission, or other valuable consideration, resulting from a real estate transaction, to or from any person other than the licensees principal

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inducing a person to break a contract to substitute a new contract with a third party
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Induces any person to a contract to break the contract for the purpose of substituting a new contract with a third party;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Salesperson or associate broker accepting compensation from any person other than their affiliated broker
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Accepts compensation as a salesperson or associate broker for any act specified in this article from any person other than his or her broker;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Paying compensation for acts performed in violation of this article or real estate licensure laws of any jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Pays compensation to any person for acts or services performed either in violation of this article or the real estate licensure laws of any other jurisdiction;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any provision of this article, any rule, or any order or final decision of the commission
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violates any provision of this article, any rule, or any order or final decision issued by the commission;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in the unlawful or unauthorized practice of law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engages in the unlawful or unauthorized practice of law as defined by the Supreme Court of Appeals of West Virginia;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing or being party to material fraud, misrepresentation, concealment, conspiracy, or other device causing reliance
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Commits or is a party to any material fraud, misrepresentation, concealment, conspiracy, collusion, trick, scheme, or other device whereby any other person relies upon the word, representation, or conduct of the licensee;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Continuing to employ or accept services of a broker, associate broker, or salesperson who is not properly licensed
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Continues in the capacity of, or accepts the services of, any broker, associate broker, or salesperson who is not properly licensed;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to disclose information or produce records for inspection by the commission
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fails to disclose any information within his or her knowledge or to produce any document, book, or record in his or her possession for inspection of and copying by the commission or its duly authorized representatives;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Accepting non-cash earnest money without disclosure in the contract
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Accepts payment other than cash or its equivalent as earnest money or other deposit unless this fact is disclosed in the contract to which the deposit relates;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Accepting, taking, or charging undisclosed compensation on expenditures made on behalf of the principal
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Accepts, takes, or charges any undisclosed compensation on expenditures made by or on behalf of the licensees principal;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Discriminating against any person in a real estate transaction in violation of federal or state anti-discrimination law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Discriminates against any person involved in a real estate transaction which is in violation of any federal or state anti-discrimination law, including any fair housing law;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to preserve records relating to any real estate transaction for five years following consummation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fails to preserve for five years following its consummation, records relating to any real estate transaction;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to maintain accurate records on the broker's trust fund account
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fails to maintain accurate records on the brokers trust fund account;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Broker failing to supervise all affiliated associate brokers and salespersons
disciplinary_grounds.quote: If a broker, fails to supervise all associate brokers and salespersons affiliated with him or her;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Breaching a fiduciary duty owed to a principal in a real estate transaction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Breaches a fiduciary duty owed by a licensee to his or her principal in a real estate transaction;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Directing a party to a lender or affiliated business expecting compensation without principal's signed consent
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Directs any party to a real estate transaction in which the licensee is involved, to any lending institution for financing or to any affiliated business with the expectation of receiving a financial incentive, rebate, or other compensation, without first obtaining from his or her principal the signed acknowledgment of and consent to the receipt of the financial incentive, rebate, or other compensation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Representing to a lending institution an amount in excess of the true sale price or false terms
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Represents to any lending institution, or other interested party either verbally or through the preparation of false documents, an amount in excess of the true and actual sale price of the real estate or terms differing from those actually agreed upon;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to disclose the licensee's true position when purchasing or acquiring an interest in a property
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fails to disclose to an owner the licensees true position if he or she directly or indirectly through a third party, purchases for himself or herself or acquires or intends to acquire any interest in or any option to purchase the property;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Lending a broker's license to any person or permitting a salesperson to operate as a broker
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Lends a brokers license to any person, including a salesperson, or permits a salesperson to operate as a broker;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of forgery, embezzlement, fraud, bribery, larceny, extortion, conspiracy to defraud, moral turpitude, or a felony
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted in a court of competent jurisdiction in this or any other jurisdiction of forgery, embezzlement, obtaining money under false pretense, bribery, larceny, extortion, conspiracy to defraud, any other similar offense, a crime involving moral turpitude, or a felony;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in any act or conduct constituting bad faith, incompetency, untrustworthiness, or dishonest dealing
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engages in any act or conduct which constitutes or demonstrates bad faith, incompetency, untrustworthiness, or dishonest, fraudulent, or improper dealing;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inducing any person to alter another licensee's fee or commission without that licensee's prior written consent
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Induces any person to alter, modify, or change another licensees fee or commission for brokerage services, without that licensees prior written consent;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Negotiating directly with a person exclusively represented by another broker without that broker's authorization
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Negotiates a real estate transaction directly with any person that is represented exclusively by another broker, unless the conduct is specifically authorized by the other broker;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining or negotiating a net listing contract where commission is only earned if sales price exceeds a set amount
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtains, negotiates, or attempts to obtain or negotiate a contract whereby the broker is entitled to a commission only to the extent that the sales price exceeds a given amount, commonly referred to as a net listing;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to furnish copies of a document to a person whose signature is affixed, upon demand
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fails or refuses, on demand, to furnish copies of a document to a person whose signature is affixed to the document;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Associate broker or salesperson representing a broker other than their employing broker
disciplinary_grounds.quote: In the case of an associate broker or salesperson, represents or attempts to represent a broker other than his or her employing broker;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to reduce a bona fide offer to writing
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fails to reduce a bona fide offer to writing;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Guaranteeing or permitting another to guarantee future profits from a real estate transaction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Guarantees, or authorizes or permits another licensee to guarantee, future profits which may result from a real estate transaction;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being disciplined by another jurisdiction for conduct that would also constitute grounds for discipline in West Virginia
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is disciplined by another jurisdiction if at least one of the grounds for that discipline is the same as or equivalent to one of the grounds for discipline in this article;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in any other act or omission in violation of professional conduct requirements established by legislative rule
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engages in any other act or omission in violation of professional conduct requirements of licensees established by legislative rule of the commission.

definition_quote.value: Broker means any person who for compensation or with the intention or expectation of receiving or collecting compensation: (1) Lists, sells, purchases, exchanges, options, rents, manages, leases, or auctions any interest in real estate; or (2) Directs or assists in the procuring of a prospect calculated or intended to result in a real estate transaction; or (3) Advertises or holds himself or herself out as engaged in, negotiates, or attempts to negotiate, or offers to engage in any activity enumerated in subdivision (1) of this subsection.
definition_quote.quote: Broker means any person who for compensation or with the intention or expectation of receiving or collecting compensation: (1) Lists, sells, purchases, exchanges, options, rents, manages, leases, or auctions any interest in real estate; or (2) Directs or assists in the procuring of a prospect calculated or intended to result in a real estate transaction; or (3) Advertises or holds himself or herself out as engaged in, negotiates, or attempts to negotiate, or offers to engage in any activity enumerated in subdivision (1) of this subsection.

value: auctioning any interest in real estate
procuring prospects for real estate transactions

broker_of_record_required.quote: No broker's license shall be issued in the name of an entity except through one of its members or officers.

pre_exam_instruction_hours.quote: Applicants for a brokers license shall provide evidence satisfactory to the commission that he or she has completed at least 180 clock-hours, equivalent to 12 college semester credit hours, in a course or courses approved by the commission

agency_relationship_types.quote: Every licensee shall disclose in writing, on the notice of agency relationship form promulgated by the commission, whether the licensee represents the seller, the buyer, the seller and the buyer, the landlord, the tenant, or the landlord and the tenant.

dual_agency_written_consent_required.quote: Acts for more than one party in a transaction without the knowledge and written consent of all parties for whom he or she acts;

initial_interview_disclosure_required.quote: The disclosure shall be made prior to any person signing any contract for representation by a licensee or a contract for the sale or purchase of real estate.

written_service_agreement_required.quote: At the time of securing any contract whereby the broker is obligated to represent a principal to a real estate transaction, every licensee shall supply a true legible copy of the contract to each person signing the contract.

value: Agency relationship disclosure (whether representing seller, buyer, or both) prior to signing
All terms and conditions of the real estate transaction
sales_contract_mandatory_disclosures.quote: Every licensee shall disclose in writing, on the notice of agency relationship form promulgated by the commission, whether the licensee represents the seller, the buyer, the seller and the buyer, the landlord, the tenant, or the landlord and the tenant.

listing_contract_termination_date_requir.quote: Any contract in which a broker is obligated to represent a principal to a real estate transaction shall contain a definite expiration date, and no provision may be included in any contract whereby the principal is required to notify the broker of his or her intention to cancel the contract after the definite expiration date.

transaction_record_retention_years.quote: Fails to preserve for five years following its consummation, records relating to any real estate transaction;

escrow_account_required.quote: Every person licensed as a broker under the provisions of this article who does not immediately deliver all funds received, in relation to a real estate transaction, to his or her principal or to a neutral escrow depository shall maintain and reconcile one or more trust fund accounts in a recognized financial institution and shall place all funds therein

commingling_of_funds_prohibited.quote: The broker may not commingle his or her own funds with trust funds and the account may not be pledged as collateral for a loan or otherwise utilized by the broker in a manner that would violate his or her fiduciary obligations in relation to the trust funds

fixed_office_required.quote: Have and maintain a definite place of business within this state, which shall be a room or rooms used for the transaction of real estate business and any allied business.

salesperson_broker_affiliation_required.quote: Conduct real estate brokerage activities only under the direct supervision and control of his or her affiliated broker, which shall be designated in the license certificate;

qualified_association_permitted.quote: for the purposes of receiving compensation, a salesperson may designate an entity to receive any compensation payable to the salesperson, including, but not limited to, a limited liability corporation or an S-corporation.

value: Person acting on own behalf as owner or lessor
Regular employees of an owner performing incidental management acts without additional compensation or as a vocation
Attorneys-at-law (though must pass written exam for broker's license)
Person holding a valid power of attorney from the owner or lessor
Person acting as receiver, trustee, administrator, executor, guardian, conservator, or under court order or authority of a deed of trust or will
Person acquiring or disposing of interest in timber or minerals, or acquiring properties for easements and rights of way
Person employed exclusively as management or rental agent for the real estate of one person or entity
Properly licensed auctioneer when retained by receiver/trustee in bankruptcy, fiduciary under deed of trust or will, or fiduciary of decedent's estate
Noncommissioned secretarial or clerical employees performing limited predetermined tasks on behalf of broker
license_exemptions.quote: The provisions of this article do not apply to: (1) Any person acting on his or her own behalf as owner or lessor of real estate.
